last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription atopic dermatitis self-management topics. The final query set returned 171 unique PubMed PMIDs, 171 fetched article records, and 167 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMID records: 35997592, 36263451, 37269189, 31733336, 35367346, 41346455, 24320105, 29117309, 19052401, 26941808, 39638592, 37163257, 39132734, 34009282, 41499674, and 26235650. Sixteen retained PubMed references were added across 15 new entries. New entries cover emollient prevention, ceramide moisturizer, bathing, bleach bath, emulsion bath, coconut oil, probiotics, evening primrose oil, vitamin E, acupuncture, mindfulness, eczema education, internet CBT, digital education, and dust-mite avoidance. Oatmeal and vitamin D topics were linked to existing entries. Moisturizer, petrolatum, wet wrap, sunflower oil, omega-3, borage oil, zinc, honey, acupressure, stress management, sleep intervention, nurse education, and allergen avoidance topics were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect. A non-NCT UMIN identifier was removed from the NCT field; one English line and one comparison-format warning were corrected. Two truthful thin-study warnings remain for the 42-person bathing trial and 39-person emulsion-bath trial.
